facts.value: ISSC recommends that you do not travel or change employers while your STEM OPT Extension application is pending.

If a change in employment is unavoidable, you must complete the following: Submit form I-983 for the new STEM employer. Go to the MyISSC eForm Portal, click on F-1 STEM OPT on the left side bar and choose the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm.
Your SEVIS record will be updated to reflect the reported changes and an updated I-20 will be issued.

To update USCIS with your change in employment, upload your new I-20 in the Unsolicited Evidence section of your STEM OPT application in the USCIS portal along with a cover letter that includes information about your change in employment and the E-Verify number of your new employer.
While on the 24-month STEM OPT Extension, you are still in F-1 immigration status and must follow regulations in order to maintain your status.
Once your STEM OPT is approved and you have received your EAD card, make sure to upload a copy of your STEM OPT EAD card in the MyISSC eForm portal.
